text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Turbo's Birthday Special Project~! 
Starting the birthday video shoot now~!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Alright, let's do this! So, where do we 
start?

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Heh-heh! Baking a rainbow-colored cake! 
It's a Turbo birthday tradition!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Whoa there, are you sure that's all you 
want~? It's your birthday project, you 
know?

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Hm? Then let's have an all-out pedal 
go-kart race! Plus opening presents, and 
then~—

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. Knowing you, Turbo-chan, aren't 
there lots more things you want to do?

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Huh, wha...? There's also 10x-speed air 
hockey, or an ultra-spicy speed-eating 
showdown...

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
"...I can do all of it? Everything Turbo 
wanted to do! You're gonna do it with 
me!?"

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, don't hold back! It's your 
once-a-year birthday, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
I'm with you all the way! Let's make this 
the most hyped birthday ever together. 
Deal?

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
“—Yaaay!! Then I'm gonna record all of it! 
It's gonna be the ultimate video!”
